free_tier.stated: USD 100 to USD 1,000 in GPU compute credits to train models, build tools or create tutorials, on RTX 4090, RTX 5090 and RTX PRO 6000 GPUs. Eligibility is aimed at Emmy compiler builders, researchers, open-source maintainers, indie developers, content creators, and artists and designers. Applications are reviewed every two weeks.
